notes: Evaluator-owned scope guidance for a source-only database command construction review. It contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review database command construction
vectors.rationale: Caller-controlled values used in a database command require a source-visible parameterization review.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: Caller-controlled data may reach a database command as command text rather than a bound value.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies command construction and a source-visible unsafe interpolation condition.

limitations: Static review cannot prove database permissions or external input validation.
